Roubic's firewood is hardwood harvested from tree removal and trimming jobs across NE Ohio, then bucked, split, and stacked to season at the Auburn Township yard. Why Order Early

The Cost of Waiting — Moreland Hills Firewood

Three reasons to line up seasoned firewood before the cold sets in.

Green Wood Won't Burn Clean

Freshly cut wood is too wet to burn well — it smokes, hisses, and throws little heat. Ordering early means you get properly seasoned hardwood instead of settling for green.

Peak-Season Demand

Seasoned firewood gets tight once the first cold snap hits and everyone orders at once. Booking ahead secures your cords while supply and scheduling are open.

Creosote & Chimney Risk

Burning unseasoned wood builds creosote in the flue faster, a known chimney-fire hazard. Dry, seasoned hardwood burns hotter and cleaner, easing that buildup.

Common Moreland Hills Firewood Questions

Moreland Hills Firewood Delivery FAQ

Six things Moreland Hills homeowners want to know before ordering.

What kind of firewood does Roubic deliver in Moreland Hills?
Seasoned, split hardwood — mainly oak, ash, maple, and cherry — harvested from Roubic's own tree removal and trimming work across NE Ohio. It's bucked, split, and seasoned at the Auburn Township yard before delivery, so it arrives dry and ready to burn rather than green.
Do you deliver firewood to Moreland Hills?
Yes. Moreland Hills is one of Roubic's five Tier 1 service areas and a short drive from the Auburn Township yard. Firewood delivery is included within Roubic's 40-mile radius, and Tier 1 orders get priority scheduling — typically a 1–3 day delivery window once the order is confirmed.
How much does firewood cost in Moreland Hills?
Firewood is sold by the cord, generally $180–$450 per cord depending on wood type, quantity, and seasoning. Premium oak, bulk multi-cord orders, and optional stacking are quoted on-site. Delivery is included within the 40-mile radius, and every order is confirmed before it leaves the yard.
Is the firewood seasoned and ready to burn?
Yes — Roubic splits and seasons its hardwood at the yard before delivery. Seasoned hardwood is dried down over several months so it lights easily and burns hot and clean, instead of the smoking and low heat you get from green wood. If you need wood for immediate use, mention it when you order so the driest stock is set aside.
Do you stack the firewood after delivery?
Delivery drops the wood at an accessible spot on your Moreland Hills property. Stacking can be arranged as an add-on — just ask when you place the order and let the driver know where you'd like it stacked.
Where does Roubic's firewood come from?
It's a byproduct of Roubic's tree removal and trimming jobs throughout NE Ohio — not bought in and resold. Usable hardwood is bucked, split, and seasoned at the Auburn Township yard, which is also why homeowners can have the good wood from their own removal turned into firewood and delivered back.
